author: ATLAS Collaboration
title: Study of the rare decays of $B^0_s$ and $B^0$ mesons into muon pairs using data collected during 2015 and 2016 with the ATLAS detector
abstract: A study of the decays $B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-$ and $B^0 \to \mu^+ \mu^-$ has been performed using 26.3 fb$^{-1}$ of 13 TeV LHC proton-proton collision data collected with the ATLAS detector in 2015 and 2016. Since the detector resolution in $\mu^+ \mu^-$ invariant mass is comparable to the $B^0_s$--$B^0$ mass difference, a single fit determines the signal yields for both decay modes. This results in a measurement of the branching fraction $\mathcal{B}(B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-) = (3.2^{+1.1}_{-1.0}) \times 10^{-9}$ and an upper limit $\mathcal{B}(B^0 \to \mu^+ \mu^-) < 4.3 \times 10^{-10}$ at 95% confidence level. The result is combined with the Run 1 ATLAS result, yielding $\mathcal{B}(B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-) = (2.8^{+0.8}_{-0.7}) \times 10^{-9}$ and $\mathcal{B}(B^0 \to \mu^+ \mu^-) < 2.1 \times 10^{-10}$ at 95% confidence level.
